verdict.rationale: Docs show Isaac Sim can run headless/standalone (Isaac Lab) and is described as extensible enough to 'integrate framework capabilities into existing testing and validation pipelines,' plus ROS 2 stack validation, suggesting it could be wired into CI. However there is no explicit CI pipeline example, no docs on automated regression-test harnesses, and no mention of CI systems like GitHub Actions/Jenkins. Missing for 10: concrete CI integration guide/examples, documented regression-test workflow, and independent evidence of teams running Isaac in CI.
